title: Splash Screen
purpose: Initial boot screen shown while OpenKaava is starting up, displaying progress and any errors
states: working - showing boot progress with step indicator
ready - boot complete, transitioning to main window
failed - boot error with recovery button
acceptance: shall display animated art while boot is in progress
shall show progress bar fill with current step indicator (e.g. 'step 2 of 3')
shall display 'Ready' message when boot completes
shall display error message and 'Continue anyway' button when boot fails
shall hold visible for minimum 800ms even if boot completes faster
shall transition to main window after minimum visible time
